items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the frost-fractured valve. Case 16 supports €52 gross for one valve.
Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover the hose if it had to be renewed with the fractured valve. Case 16 supports €30 gross for one hose.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover necessary repair labour. Three hours at €100 gross give €300, consistent with Case 16.

Sections 3.6(c) and 7.1.7(e) distinguish excluded contractor equipment from consumables actually used in the covered repair. Allow €9 gross if this line is for those consumables, consistent with Case 16.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance for the plumbing repair. Allow €63 gross for that visit, consistent with Case 16.

Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging used to locate the insured escape. Allow €48 gross for the camera-use line, below both the Case 16 upper bound and the €2,500 aggregate leak-location cap.

Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5 exclude outdoor frost damage without the optional cover, which is not shown as agreed. No internal escape reached the facade, so §2.4.3 does not apply and the payable amount is zero.
Section 3.5(b) excludes removal of plaster loosened by uninsured outdoor frost. No amount is payable.
Sections 3.5(b) and 7.1.7 exclude renewal of the base plaster on an elevation damaged only by an uninsured peril. No amount is payable.
Sections 3.5(d) and 7.1.10 bar the upgrade. Because the underlying facade work is uninsured, there is no allowance even for equivalent plain render.
Section 3.5(b) excludes re-forming the substrate beneath the uninsured outdoor frost damage. No amount is payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes all finish coats associated with uninsured outdoor frost damage, regardless of the number applied. No amount is payable.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate undamaged elevations for a uniform appearance. No amount is payable.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes priming associated with uninsured exterior frost damage. No amount is payable.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.11 exclude labour attributable to uninsured facade work. None of the five hours is payable.
Under §§7.1.12–7.1.13, a lump sum for uninsured facade work is not payable, and §9.6 bars any unallocated charge. Nothing identifies covered work in this line.
